description: This Java class 'DefaultCommandConfig' implements the 'CommandConfig' interface. It provides configuration settings related to command timeouts such as default and maximum timeout durations, which are loaded from a scoped configuration object. The class offers a static factory method to instantiate itself from a TypeSafe Config object and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultCommandConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing CommandConfig, encapsulating command timeout configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultCommandConfig instance from a given Config object, using a specified config path and fallback values.
